packageRules.description: TS 7 drops the JS compiler API that Nest CLI, typescript-eslint and Next's typecheck use (spec §3). A major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval
eslint-config-next's plugins don't support ESLint 10 yet (spec §3). A major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval
The smoke jobs' Playwright image must match @playwright/test, so both move in one PR (workflow policy Rule 13)
Node is 24, Vercel's runtime (AGENTS.md). Pinning engines would set it to the newest Node, and .nvmrc keeps the major only, so both change by hand (quarterly in docs/operations.md)
Node is 24, Vercel's runtime (AGENTS.md). Pinning engines would set it to the newest Node, and .nvmrc keeps the major only, so both change by hand (quarterly in docs/operations.md)
undici-types is pinned at the version @types/node locks, so it moves by hand with @types/node (docs/development.md)

Production Neon runs Postgres 17, and local, test and backup images match it because pg_dump refuses newer servers (docs/deployment.md). A major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval, to take with Neon's upgrade

pg 9 gives sslmode=require libpq's meaning: encryption without checking the certificate. Every check would still pass, because local and test Postgres don't use TLS. A major waits on the Dependency Dashboard for approval. Before approving, check every connection string pg reads says sslmode=verify-full, previews' included (docs/deployment.md, TLS: sslmode=verify-full)
infra/ is OpenTofu, so providers resolve against OpenTofu's registry, whose hashes .terraform.lock.hcl records (D93). Provider bumps run next to secrets and always wait for review
required_version names OpenTofu, not Terraform, and moves by hand with infra/.opentofu-version and install-tofu.sh's sha256 (quarterly in docs/operations.md)

Dev-only tooling that runs in secret-free jobs and never shapes the production build merges itself once the required checks pass (D88). Builds, runtime code, the Vercel CLI, Playwright, Actions, images and majors wait for review. @types/node moves by hand with undici-types
